full_page.content:
1911
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 7 Cont.
Nov. 7th Mayor J.T. Lennon re-Elected by a majority of 221. 221 over D.J. Cashin. Votes cast 6902 & 6681 13583
Nov. 30th Thanksgiving Day 18 Cardinals receive their insignia. Fr. Sol. sang M.C. Anniv. in Saint Josephes Church- Deacon afterwards.
Page 8
Dec. 2nd Tho's Mullen & Wm. Bergen received first appointment to serve.
Nov. 30 (continued) Rev. Fr. Lugel left for Detroit, sorry to leave Yonkers ..
Dec. 4th First heavy snowstorm
Dec. 3rd Said (Fr. Sol) two holy Masses in Holy Eucharist Church.
Dec. 23rd $5.00 from Mrs. Mary Reade for Altar-boys.
Dec. 31st Happy Death of Altar boy Martin Kennedy at 3 A.M. Had served 93 times during 1911 A.D. A dear good boy of eleven years. R.I.P.
